purpose: Apply the unchanged P0741 SINGS-plus-AllWISE fusion to the two validation galaxies and produce complete baryonic maps without opening any velocity target.
permittedInputs: P0745A derived validation baryonic maps, hashes, geometry, and audit
Frozen P0740 validation AllWISE W1 intensity and uncertainty arrays, WCS headers, coadd IDs, and cutout geometry
Validation SINGS IRAC channel-1 image and weight arrays needed by the predeclared cross-calibration
forbiddenInputs: SPARC observed rotation speeds or errors
Any gravity-formula residual, score, or fitted parameter

processing.method: Bit-for-bit P0741 fusion implementation generalized only to honor the split and parent path named by this config.
processing.wiseTileBackground: robust median in the outer 15 percent border
processing.wiseMosaic: inverse-variance combination of every frozen coadd
processing.wiseForegroundSuppression: same 12-MAD compact-residual rule used by P0741
processing.crossCalibration: median positive SINGS/WISE ratio over the unchanged overlap mask, with fixed quadrant sensitivity audit
processing.fusion: beam-matched SINGS inside its valid footprint and scaled beam-matched WISE outside it
processing.stellarMassCalibration: one normalization to published 3.6 micron luminosity times universal M/L=0.5
processing.gasMassCalibration: retain P0745A normalization to 1.36 times published H I mass

claimBoundary: P0745B is a frozen validation-split observational fusion test, not a gravity-formula score.
The per-galaxy WISE/SINGS factor is an instrument cross-calibration and cannot be chosen from any velocity residual.
The algorithm and gates were frozen before validation SINGS or WISE arrays were opened by this stage.
No velocity target is opened, and both holdout galaxies remain sealed.
